description: This Kotlin source file defines the HeroCard class, a custom UI component for an Android TV application. The class extends CardView and is used to display a compact, focusable card within a hero banner row, with specific layout dimensions and styling tailored for TV navigation.

classes.name: HeroCard
classes.description: A custom CardView representing a hero banner card with fixed dimensions, styling, and focus behavior for TV UI. It includes a method to set the display title.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title text displayed in the HeroCard.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to actual pixel values based on device density.
